name: Maria Santay
office: City of El Monte, City Treasurer

items.text: Maria Santay is a licensed insurance agent running for city treasurer.

sentences.text: Maria Santay is a licensed insurance agent running for city treasurer.

items.text: She says she wants to bring fiscal transparency and accountability to the city's finances. She supports strengthening reserves, controlling spending, and reviewing city contracts for efficiency. She also proposes using state and federal resources to add housing while listening to community input.
